# Chainlink VRF dependency subset

These three Solidity files are unmodified files from the published `@chainlink/contracts@1.5.0` npm archive, copied with their SPDX MIT headers and original documentation. Only the transitive dependencies of IVRFCoordinatorV2Plus and VRFV2PlusClient are included, avoiding unrelated network/bridge toolchains. Source: https://github.com/smartcontractkit/chainlink-evm . Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@chainlink/contracts/v/1.5.0 .
